reasons: Aggregation differs: Datadog sum:redis.keys adds keys across all selected series, but the candidate uses avg(), which averages per-db key counts and gives a different value.

Host filter dropped: the Datadog $host template variable (prefix host, default *) should become a host matcher such as host_name=~"$host", but the candidate has no matcher, so the series set is not the same.
Outcome: an exact translation exists (sum over redis.db.keys with the host matcher, subject to the dataset's host label name), so translated with avg is the wrong result.
Quantity and unit match: redis.db.keys is a gauge of keys in '{key}', the same quantity as redis.keys; the $scope and $key variables without a usable prefix are correctly dropped.
